easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Yannik, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Yannik until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
